## Summary

P25.4 deliverable 2 — the **curated coarse-dataset adapters**, stacked on
`devin/p25-5-live-extraction`. The counsel-flipped coarse-international sources
(ADR-085 flips landed 2026-09-15) move beyond page-only provenance capture into
real aggregate-only, typed, evidenced, timestamped claims — fail-closed on
content drift, append-only on changed snapshots, and honest about every surface
that cannot be reached.

## What changed

### `carnegie_ai_gsi` — embedded-dataset adapter

The AI Global Surveillance Index page is a Next.js client-rendered interactive:
the reviewed dataset lives inside one of the page's `<script src>` chunks as a
minified array of 75 per-country objects (`country`, ISO-2 `id`, five boolean
flags `chinese`/`us`/`city`/`facial`/`policing`, `description`,
relevant-company labels).

- `discover_more` resolves the page's chunk links into bounded `dataset_chunk`
  targets (`max_dataset_targets` — a page that grew past the reviewed bound is
  `ContentDrift`, never a silent truncation).
- The chunk carrying the reviewed `entry_marker` parses **strictly**: every
  entry must match the full field shape or the whole capture fails loud.
- Emits per-country membership + five typed boolean flag claims + vendor
  supplier claims, each with `{source_url, retrieved_date, extraction_method,
  locator}` evidence and byte-range locators into the captured chunk.

### `facial_recognition_world_map` — Google-Sheets adapter

The Surfshark map page links a Google Sheet; the reviewed spec resolves six
continent gviz-CSV sheets (name + gid bound in vocabulary). Strict five-column
header check (`Country / Facial recognition status / Source 1 / Source 2 /
Notes`); a changed, added, renamed, or undeclared sheet is `ContentDrift`.
194 data rows / 193 unique countries → typed status claims preserving raw
literals and row-level evidence. **Egypt appears twice with conflicting
statuses — both rows are preserved, never silently reconciled.**

### `aspi_mapping_chinas_tech_giants` — honest refusal

The China Tech Map's host WAF answers 403 to local egress **and** to the Cloud
Run vantage probe (the MuckRock precedent). Alternate ASPI hosts are reachable
but the relevant report/map paths stay blocked. No bypass, no fabricated
vendor-country rows — the run records an `access_restricted` disappearance.
Egress vantage / HG-04 outreach stays owed to P25.7 d3.

### Versioned vocabulary

`connectors/data/coarse_international_vocab.toml` carries the adapter specs
(surface kinds, entry markers, sheet names+gids, predicate allowlist,
forbidden non-aggregate column tokens) and all 193 reviewed FRWM country-name
→ subject-id mappings (`GB-ENG`/`GB-SCT`, `XK`, `FM`, `SZ`, `GM`, `TL`, …).

### `parsing/document.py`

`html_script_srcs` — pure byte-level `<script src>` extraction alongside the
P25.5 helpers (no network, no capture access).
